description: A React component named EnhancedWorkflowEvents that displays and filters workflow event logs with notes, status, tags, and timestamps. It handles fetching notes asynchronously and includes UI controls for filtering, sorting, and focusing on specific nodes.

methods.name: formatDuration
methods.description: Formats a duration in milliseconds into a human-readable string, e.g., '5m 30s' or '—' if undefined.

methods.name: formatTimestamp
methods.description: Converts a timestamp string into a localized date string or returns '—' if invalid.
